author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing the Panasonic Whisper Green Select. This bathroom exhaust fan has a light and several wiring options, this is just one. I’m not using the multi-speed module and capped the signal wires. I also capped the blue wire for the light. The wiring configuration I did requires two switches, one for the fan and one for the light. Many thanks to Panasonic for sending this fan for my clients’ project
title: Bathroom Exhaust Fan Electrical Tips - #shorts #exhaustfan #brandpartner
